headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Tracking runs to Dec. 31, where the odds are limited war 66%, escalated 15%, MOU-style 12% and comprehensive 7%. After a Democratic sweep in the midterms, Trump says there is no immediate plan to strike Iran but the US is "locked and loaded," and Iran's chief negotiator says Americans voted against war. The IRGC claims four tankers destroyed by mines and a US drone downed, but neither claim is confirmed, so no tripwire fires and the odds hold while mediators wait for answers from both sides.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
Iran offers a concrete cut in enrichment capacity, in text or on the record
